customerSessionActivity.caption: A customer is active when a human session that is not a cook, admin, bot, or impersonation last interacted in the range. Long-lived sessions only appear in the bucket of their latest activity.

descriptions.EMPTY: No Stripe payment prepared yet. Checkout is still pending, or a prior preparation was reset.
descriptions.SETUP: Card details are saved. The amount will be charged automatically on the planned pull date.
descriptions.SETUP_PAST: Card details are saved. The planned pull date is past; the amount will be charged automatically shortly.
descriptions.PAYED: Customer paid. The cook share sits on the Stripe Connect balance and still needs a bank payout.
descriptions.TRANSFERRED: Stripe paid the cook share to their bank. Price changes and handovers are blocked.
descriptions.FAILED: Payment failed or was canceled. Checkout or re-preparation is needed.
descriptions.PAYED_OUT_OF_SYSTEM: Marked as paid outside Stripe (for example wire). Optionally check whether Stripe already paid out.

plannedPullPast.EMPTY: Already in the past. Will be pulled right after the customer enters payment data.
plannedPullPast.SETUP: Already in the past. The automatic pull should run shortly.
